text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: What are you doing out here alone, so late at night, my dear familia? I saw you up above from the sky... and before I even realized it, here I am, having descended.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このような夜更けに
一人でどうしたのじゃ、
我が眷属よ。
空から見かけて、
思わず降りてきてしまったではないか。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: ...? Perhaps... you were waiting for me? Though I don't recall us making any promises...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？
もしや、
わらわを待っておったのか？
何か約束をしていたわけではないはずじゃが……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! S-So you remembered? Were you just hoping I'd pass around here by chance?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！
お、
覚えておったのか。
それで、
こんな場所で
わらわが偶然通りがかるのを待っていたと？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: What an absurdly random idea to have... No, this is the same place where we once soared through the night sky together, is it not? Perhaps, that memory lingered in both of our hearts.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんという行き当たりばったりな……
……いや、
以前にお主と夜空を飛んだのもここじゃったな。
互いに、
思い出深かったということか。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Mm, wait just a moment. Since fate has chosen to reunite us like this, it is only proper that we mark the moment accordingly...
text_block_list.orig_text:
む、
少し待つがよい。
せっかく偶然を乗り越え出会えたのじゃ。
相応しく──

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Now, we're in a place where nobody else can pry. ...I grant you permission... to place your gift on me, with your own hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
誰の目にも届かぬ
二人だけの場所じゃ。
……プレゼントを、
その手でわらわに着けることを許す。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Umu. You've just earned my praise...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむ。
褒めて遣わす……♪
